Soft pieces

Fish baked in paper

Hal sütőpapírban

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 2 portions

Mash until smooth enough for 6 months, with no bone and no firm vegetable lumps. Offer a small spoonful while it is warm.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 100 g boneless salmon, trout, cod, or hake (fillet, not carp)
  • 1 small leek (white part only, well washed and sliced)
  • 1 medium ripe tomato (fresh, not dried tomato)
  • 1 small zucchini (diced)
  • 1 tsp olive oil

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Lay the fillet on baking paper with the leek, fresh tomato, and zucchini.
  2. Drizzle with the oil, fold a parcel, and bake at 180 C until the fish flakes and the vegetables are soft, about 20 minutes.
  3. Open the parcel, flake the fish, and check every flake for bones.
  4. Mash the fish and vegetables together until smooth enough for 6 months.

Adjusted

The usual parcel was often carp, sometimes with salty dried tomato, and Brussels sprouts do not cook down to a mash here. At 6 months the fish cannot be left in large flakes.

Bake a boneless salmon, trout, cod, or hake fillet with leek, fresh tomato, and zucchini, not carp or dried tomato. Flake it, check for bones, and mash it with the vegetables.
